# Implementation Plan: Spec-Kit Project Scaffolding Script

<!-- Generated by Spec-Kit /speckit.plan | Session: 8eb724b4-5309-47ce-817f-68e0bf6b32fa | Date: 2026-01-27 -->

**Branch**: `002-speckit-copy-script` | **Date**: 2026-01-27 | **Spec**: `specs/002-speckit-copy-script/spec.md`
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/002-speckit-copy-script/spec.md`

## Summary

Build a professional PowerShell 7+ script (`Copy-SpecKit.ps1`) that automates copying the Spec-Kit framework files from a source repository to a new project destination. The script categorizes files into tiers (Framework, Core Agents, Domain Modules), supports preview/dry-run mode, selective domain inclusion, force overwrite, and provides rich console output with post-copy guidance. It will be placed at `.specify/scripts/powershell/Copy-SpecKit.ps1`.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: PowerShell 7.0+ (cross-platform compatible)
**Primary Dependencies**: None (PowerShell built-in cmdlets only)
**Storage**: Filesystem operations (Copy-Item, New-Item, Test-Path)
**Testing**: Pester 5.x (PowerShell testing framework)
**Target Platform**: Cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux via PowerShell 7+)
**Project Type**: Single script with supporting test file
**Performance Goals**: Complete copy of ~50 files in <5 seconds
**Constraints**: No external module dependencies; must work with stock PowerShell 7+
**Scale/Scope**: ~50 framework files across 6 directory trees; ~12 domain-specific files in 2 domains
